methodology: One whole-batch independent factual web review of all 58 frozen REVIEW_ITEMS, under main CONTENT_LOOP procedure revision 17b97a2 and applicable CRITIQUE_RUBRIC A, C, D and F; five preexisting holds remain holds.

Live dexonline JSON was fetched directly because the browser could not open JSON: Mănușă first, then the remaining 57 serially with at least 2.1 seconds after every response. Selected exact DEX09/DOOM3 IDs and lexical headwords were checked anew; stress/editorial marks, homograph indices and the Mistreț feminine suffix were treated as metadata, not unrelated lemmas.

All 129 authored edge captions, relation types and orientations were judged against live browsed primary/secondary Romanian sources. Indexed primary passages were used where dynamic pages/PDF fetching failed; notably the sewing-manual wool/button passages. No source claims from adjacent species were borrowed. The primary Milvus PDF was freshly downloaded and page 3 visually inspected.

The official Lipici school PDF was fetched anew and its pages 8 and 15–18 checked: notebook-label repair only. Current Pictus text supports bookbinding, not an assumed restoration claim. Fresh Romsilva squirrel/acorn evidence replaces reliance on the inaccessible Padeș-only citation.

The frozen 205 distinct proposed input keys were checked with bundled normalization_map against normalized_index, labels, node labels/aliases and discovery-world labels/aliases/snapshots; every resolved owner is unchanged and no foreign owner is stolen. Stejarii, hârtii, ac and coadă collisions remain excluded or held. All 20 existing-owner families retain their exact current senses.

Factual acceptance establishes lexical/claim correctness only. It neither relaxes the 4–8 distinct-neighbour, at-least-two-existing, at-most-two-batch or same-category requirements nor approves new curated rounds/hidden targets. Final aggregate topology and playable selection remain subject to the independent quality verdict and owner-applied trims.

items.rationale: Exact anatomical flight-organ sense and aripii/aripi family; bird, butterfly, bee and swallow organs are supported, and all part_of edges point from organ to animal.
Modern bird-nesting construction and neuter family; SOR supports stork and swallow nests and directly reports stork nests in trees, without assigning tree nesting to swallows.
Living animal covering comes from DEX09, while DOOM3 homograph1 is glossed skin/coat; only blană/blănii are retained, and fur on the named fox, bear, dog and cat is explicitly supported.

Exact anatomical sense and ghearei/gheare family; cat and bear evidence is explicit, and the freshly rendered Milvus fox-labelled diagram supports the claw-presence inference without borrowing adjacent lynx text or claiming retractility.
DEX distinguishes material/physical sheets from documents and money; notebook paper, printed book pages and pencil/pen writing are explicit, while Hartă-owned hârtii remains excluded.
DEX 841971 is the thick-paper material homograph, not the regional textile entry; directed carton-to-paper is_a and qualified box/notebook/book-cover uses are supported.
Material sense and sticlei are exact; plural sticle is marked for objects and excluded, while window glass, glass mirror/jar examples and possible optical-glass lenses support the qualified captions.

Only singular material keys are retained because DOOM3 assigns cauciucuri to tyres; primary sources support tyres on wheels, rubber soles and rubber household gloves without making the whole wheel rubber.

DOOM3 substance homograph2 and lipiciuri family are exact; current Pictus text supports paper/cardboard and bookbinding, and the official school PDF supports only notebook-label reattachment, not full notebook restoration.
